metadata.name: McCullochPittsNeuron
metadata.author: McCulloch, W. S.; Pitts, W.
metadata.description: All-or-none excitatory-count threshold with absolute inhibitory veto

threshold.description: I is a signed Q32.0 transport: non-negative excitatory count, or -1 when any inhibitory afferent is active

extensions.input_encoding: I=-1 means absolute inhibitory veto; I in [0, 2^31-1] is active excitatory-afferent count
extensions.source_scope_note: The hand API exposes excitatory_count and inhibitory_active separately. The schema folds them through encode_hardware_input only at the RTL boundary.
extensions.delay_scope_note: One schema step maps afferents at t-1 to activity at t; no hidden membrane or delay state is introduced.
extensions.silicon_cosim_note: Signed Q32.0 represents the complete input domain exactly and preserves both registered and folded truth tables.
